title: 日本 SPring-8 同步輻射設施~SPring-8 synchrotron facility
focus: 8 GeV 高能儲存環的硬 X 光取得、注入、束團純度與 SPring-8-II 降能升級~Hard X-ray generation, injection, bunch purity and the SPring-8-II lower-energy upgrade of an 8 GeV ring
summary: 以 SPring-8 的 8 GeV、1436 m 儲存環為對象，先理解高電子能量如何讓真空內波盪器的基頻直接落在硬 X 光，再拆解 SACLA 直線加速器直接注入、束團純度量測與同調分率的工程，最後推導 SPring-8-II 為何改用 6 GeV 五彎消色散晶格加阻尼扭擺磁鐵，把發射度從 2.4 nm·rad 壓到 50 pm·rad 並在同一隧道內更換整座環。~Using SPring-8's 8 GeV, 1436 m ring, first see how high electron energy puts the fundamental of an in-vacuum undulator directly in the hard X-ray range, then work through direct injection from the SACLA linac, bunch-purity measurement and coherent-fraction engineering, and finally derive why SPring-8-II moves to a 6 GeV five-bend achromat with damping wigglers to cut emittance from 2.4 nm·rad to 50 pm·rad while replacing the whole ring inside the same tunnel.

units.anchor: 8 GeV 儲存環（1436 m，44 單元）~8 GeV ring (1436 m, 44 cells)
units.title: 高電子能量與硬 X 光的系統邊界~High electron energy and the hard X-ray system boundary
units.mechanism: SPring-8 選擇 8 GeV，是為了讓彎轉磁鐵的臨界能量落在數十 keV，並讓波盪器的基頻直接涵蓋 10 keV 以上的硬 X 光。代價是輻射損失隨 E⁴ 暴增：每圈損失接近 10 MeV，必須由 508.58 MHz 的射頻系統補回；周長 1435.95 m 給出 2436 個束團桶與 208.8 kHz 的迴轉頻率，4 段 30 m 長直線段則容納超長波盪器。這組邊界條件決定了射頻功率、真空腔的熱負載與整座設施的用電。~SPring-8 chose 8 GeV so that the bending-magnet critical energy lands at tens of keV and undulator fundamentals cover hard X-rays above 10 keV directly. The price is radiation loss growing as E⁴: nearly 10 MeV per turn must be restored by the 508.58 MHz RF system; the 1435.95 m circumference gives 2436 buckets and a 208.8 kHz revolution frequency, and four 30 m straights house very long undulators. These boundary conditions fix RF power, chamber heat load and the facility's electricity use.
units.model: 臨界能量 ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV。每圈損失 U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×4096/39.3 m ≈ 9.2 MeV，100 mA 時 P = U₀·I ≈ 0.92 MW（未含插件磁鐵）。諧波數 h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436，迴轉頻率 c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz。~Critical energy ε_c = 0.665·E²·B = 0.665×64×0.679 T ≈ 28.9 keV. Loss per turn U₀ = 88.46·E⁴/ρ = 88.46×4096/39.3 m ≈ 9.2 MeV, so at 100 mA P = U₀·I ≈ 0.92 MW before insertion devices. Harmonic number h = C·f_RF/c = 1435.95×508.58×10⁶/2.998×10⁸ ≈ 2436 and the revolution frequency is c/C ≈ 208.8 kHz.
units.verify: 從射頻發射機的前向與反射功率算出送入束流的功率，與 U₀·I 比較；在彎轉磁鐵光束線以多片已知吸收片的穿透比反推 28.9 keV 的臨界能量；用束流電流監視器的迴轉諧波核對 208.8 kHz，並以填充圖監視器確認 2436 個桶的占用情形。~Compute the power delivered to the beam from the RF transmitter's forward and reflected power and compare with U₀·I; infer the 28.9 keV critical energy on a bending-magnet beamline from transmission ratios through several known absorbers; confirm 208.8 kHz from the revolution harmonics of the current monitor and check occupancy of the 2436 buckets with a fill-pattern monitor.
units.failure: 把低能量環的設計經驗直接放大到 8 GeV，會低估 E⁴ 的輻射損失：射頻腔數量或冷卻不足，電流爬升到一半就因腔體過熱或射頻桶縮小而丟束。~Scaling a low-energy ring design straight to 8 GeV underestimates the E⁴ radiation loss: with too few cavities or too little cooling, the current ramp stalls halfway as cavities overheat or the RF bucket shrinks and the beam is lost.
units.misconception: 電子能量加倍，輻射損失也只是加倍。~Doubling electron energy only doubles the radiation loss.

units.anchor: DBA 晶格與 SPring-8-II 五彎消色散~DBA lattice and the SPring-8-II five-bend achromat
units.title: 發射度、阻尼扭擺磁鐵與降能的取捨~Emittance, damping wigglers and the trade-off of lowering energy
units.mechanism: SPring-8 現行雙彎消色散晶格的水平發射度約 2.4 nm·rad。SPring-8-II 把能量降到 6 GeV 並換成每單元五個彎轉的五彎消色散，彎轉角立方的縮減讓裸晶格發射度降到約 111 pm·rad；再用阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加輻射阻尼，把發射度壓到約 50 pm·rad，電流提高到 200 mA。降能損失的光子能量由更短週期的真空內波盪器補回，而輻射損失與用電反而下降，這是「綠色升級」的核心取捨。~The present double-bend achromat of SPring-8 has a horizontal emittance of about 2.4 nm·rad. SPring-8-II lowers the energy to 6 GeV and adopts a five-bend achromat with five bends per cell; the cube of the smaller bend angle brings the bare-lattice emittance to about 111 pm·rad, damping wigglers then add radiation damping to reach about 50 pm·rad, and the current rises to 200 mA. The photon energy lost by lowering the energy is recovered with shorter-period in-vacuum undulators, while radiation loss and electricity fall, which is the central trade-off of the green upgrade.
units.model: ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³：現行 88 彎、8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸，θ = 71.4 mrad，F_DBA = 0.0645）得 ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad，與實際 2.4 nm 相符。SPring-8-II 220 彎、6 GeV（γ² = 1.38×10⁸，θ = 28.6 mrad）：同一 F 給 79 pm，理論極限 F_TME = 0.0215 給 26 pm，設計裸發射度 111 pm。阻尼扭擺磁鐵：ε = ε₀/(1 + U_w/U₀)，要從 111 降到 50 pm 需 U_w/U₀ ≈ 1.2，即扭擺磁鐵的輻射損失約為彎轉磁鐵的 1.2 倍。~ε ≈ F·C_q·γ²·θ³: the present 88 bends at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸, θ = 71.4 mrad, F_DBA = 0.0645) give ε ≈ 2.2 nm·rad, consistent with the actual 2.4 nm. SPring-8-II with 220 bends at 6 GeV (γ² = 1.38×10⁸, θ = 28.6 mrad): the same F gives 79 pm, the TME limit F = 0.0215 gives 26 pm, and the design bare emittance is 111 pm. Damping wigglers: ε = ε₀/(1 + U_w/U₀), so going from 111 to 50 pm needs U_w/U₀ ≈ 1.2, that is wiggler radiation loss about 1.2 times that of the bends.
units.verify: 以 X 光針孔相機或干涉式尺寸監視器在已知 β 處量束流尺寸反推發射度；逐步關閉阻尼扭擺磁鐵間隙，記錄發射度隨扭擺輻射損失（由射頻功率增量推得）的變化，核對 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) 關係；同時監看能散與束團長度，因為扭擺磁鐵也會改變它們。~Measure beam size at a point of known β with an X-ray pinhole camera or interferometric size monitor and invert to emittance; close the damping-wiggler gaps step by step, log emittance versus wiggler radiation loss (inferred from the RF power increment) and check the 1/(1 + U_w/U₀) relation; also watch energy spread and bunch length, since wigglers change those too.
units.failure: 阻尼扭擺磁鐵若放在色散不為零的位置，自身的量子激發會抵銷阻尼效果，發射度不降反升；設計時若只看阻尼項而忽略色散，整個 50 pm 的目標就落空。~Damping wigglers placed where dispersion is non-zero add their own quantum excitation that cancels the damping, and emittance rises instead of falling; a design that counts only the damping term and ignores dispersion misses the whole 50 pm target.
units.misconception: 降低電子能量一定會讓光源變差，升級只能往高能量走。~Lowering electron energy always makes a source worse, so upgrades can only go to higher energy.

units.anchor: 真空內波盪器（λ_u = 32 mm，4.5 m）~In-vacuum undulator (λ_u = 32 mm, 4.5 m)
units.title: 8 GeV 波盪器的基頻、諧波與功率密度~Undulator fundamentals, harmonics and power density at 8 GeV
units.mechanism: SPring-8 是真空內波盪器的發源地之一：磁列放進真空腔，間隙可關到數毫米，讓 32 mm 週期在 8 GeV 下的基頻就落在 5 到 13 keV，不必依賴高次諧波。但 8 GeV 的功率密度極高：軸上功率密度隨 E⁴ 增加，標準 4.5 m 波盪器達數百 kW/mrad²，30 m 直線段內的 25 m 超長波盪器更高一個量級，因此前端光闌、吸收器與第一光學元件的熱設計是這類光束線的核心。~SPring-8 is one of the birthplaces of the in-vacuum undulator: the magnet array sits inside the vacuum chamber and the gap closes to a few millimetres, so a 32 mm period at 8 GeV puts the fundamental itself at 5 to 13 keV without relying on high harmonics. But the power density at 8 GeV is extreme: the on-axis power density grows as E⁴, a standard 4.5 m undulator reaches hundreds of kW/mrad², and the 25 m undulator in a 30 m straight is another order of magnitude higher, so the thermal design of front-end masks, absorbers and first optics is the heart of these beamlines.
units.model: 8 GeV、γ² = 2.45×10⁸、λ_u = 32 mm：K = 2.2 時 λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å，即 5.55 keV，第 3、第 5 諧波為 16.7 與 27.8 keV；K = 1 時基頻 12.7 keV。取 B₀ = 0.8 T（K ≈ 2.4）、L = 4.5 m（N = 140）、I = 0.1 A：總功率 P = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L·I = 0.633×64×0.64×4.5×0.1 ≈ 11.7 kW，軸上功率密度 ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×0.8×4096×0.1×140 ≈ 497 kW/mrad²。~At 8 GeV, γ² = 2.45×10⁸ and λ_u = 32 mm: for K = 2.2, λ₁ = λ_u(1+K²/2)/(2γ²) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV, with 3rd and 5th harmonics at 16.7 and 27.8 keV; for K = 1 the fundamental is 12.7 keV. With B₀ = 0.8 T (K ≈ 2.4), L = 4.5 m (N = 140) and I = 0.1 A: total power P = 0.633·E²·B₀²·L·I = 0.633×64×0.64×4.5×0.1 ≈ 11.7 kW and on-axis power density ≈ 10.84·B₀·E⁴·I·N = 10.84×0.8×4096×0.1×140 ≈ 497 kW/mrad².
units.verify: 磁量測台上以霍爾探針取得 B₀(g)、相位誤差與場積分；裝機後用光束線單色器掃描基頻與諧波峰位核對 K(g) 表；以前端量熱式吸收器（冷卻水流量乘溫升）量總功率，與 11.7 kW 的估計比較，並用熱像儀檢查固定光闌的溫度分佈是否與有限元素模型一致。~Obtain B₀(g), phase error and field integrals with a Hall probe on the magnet bench; after installation scan fundamental and harmonic peaks with the beamline monochromator to check the K(g) table; measure total power with a calorimetric front-end absorber (cooling-water flow times temperature rise) against the 11.7 kW estimate, and check the fixed-mask temperature map with a thermal camera against the finite-element model.
units.failure: 若真空內波盪器的射頻遮蔽銅箔在小間隙下與束流失配，束流的尾場把銅箔加熱、變形甚至燒穿，碎片落在磁列上造成真空惡化與退磁，整支波盪器需拆下修復。~If the RF-shielding copper foil of an in-vacuum undulator mismatches the beam at small gap, the beam wakefield heats, deforms or burns through the foil, debris lands on the magnet array, vacuum degrades and magnets demagnetise, and the whole undulator must be removed for repair.
units.misconception: 波盪器的功率密度只跟電流有關，與電子能量無關。~Undulator power density depends only on current, not on electron energy.

units.anchor: SACLA C 頻段直線加速器直接注入~Direct injection from the SACLA C-band linac
units.title: 低發射度注入器與注入效率~Low-emittance injector and injection efficiency
units.mechanism: 自 2020 年起 SPring-8 以相鄰的 SACLA 8 GeV C 頻段直線加速器直接注入儲存環，取代原本的 1 GeV 直線加速器加 8 GeV 增能環。直線加速器的束流歸一化發射度約 1 µm·rad，在 8 GeV 下幾何發射度只有數十 pm，比儲存環的接受度小得多，因此注入束流可以用很小的振幅進入，減少損失與對儲存束流的擾動；這也是 SPring-8-II 小孔徑真空腔與低發射度環所必需的。~Since 2020 SPring-8 has been injected directly from the neighbouring SACLA 8 GeV C-band linac, replacing the original 1 GeV linac plus 8 GeV booster. The linac beam has a normalised emittance of about 1 µm·rad, which at 8 GeV is a geometric emittance of only tens of picometres, far below the ring acceptance, so the injected beam enters with a very small amplitude, reducing losses and disturbance to the stored beam; this is also a prerequisite for the small-aperture chambers and low-emittance ring of SPring-8-II.
units.model: C 頻段 5.712 GHz 加速結構梯度取 35 MV/m（教學假設）：8 GeV 需 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m 的有效加速長度。幾何發射度 ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad，儲存環接受度若為 10 nm·rad，則注入束流只佔其 0.6%；能量偏差若為 0.1%，在色散 η = 0.1 m 處對應 0.1 mm 的軌道偏移，遠小於 3% 的動量接受度。~Taking a C-band 5.712 GHz structure gradient of 35 MV/m (teaching assumption), 8 GeV needs 8000 MV/35 MV/m ≈ 230 m of active length. Geometric emittance ε = ε_n/γ = 1×10⁻⁶/15 656 ≈ 64 pm·rad; if the ring acceptance is 10 nm·rad the injected beam occupies 0.6% of it; an energy error of 0.1% at dispersion η = 0.1 m corresponds to a 0.1 mm orbit offset, far inside the 3% momentum acceptance.
units.verify: 在傳輸線末端以螢光屏或 OTR 配合四極掃描量注入束流的發射度與能散；以儲存環 DCCT 的電流階梯和傳輸線的電荷監視器算注入效率；用逐圈 BPM 看注入束流在頭幾百圈的振盪振幅並確認阻尼；以束流損失監視器定位注入時的損失位置。~Measure injected-beam emittance and energy spread at the end of the transfer line with a screen or OTR and a quadrupole scan; compute injection efficiency from the ring DCCT current step and the transfer-line charge monitor; watch the injected beam's oscillation amplitude over the first few hundred turns with turn-by-turn BPMs and confirm damping; and locate injection losses with beam-loss monitors.
units.failure: 直線加速器與儲存環的射頻相位或能量若漂移，注入束流落在射頻桶邊緣，一半以上在頭幾圈內丟失，損失打在注入段真空腔與波盪器，劑量與退磁風險同時上升。~If the RF phase or energy between linac and ring drifts, the injected beam lands at the edge of the RF bucket, more than half is lost within the first turns, and the losses strike injection-section chambers and undulators, raising dose and demagnetisation risk together.
units.misconception: 注入器只要能量對了，發射度大小無關緊要。~An injector only needs the right energy; its emittance does not matter.

units.anchor: 束團純度量測與 RF 擊出~Bunch-purity measurement and RF knock-out
units.title: 時間結構、束團純度與單光子計數~Time structure, bunch purity and single-photon counting
units.mechanism: 時間解析實驗需要隔離的單束團，其相鄰桶的雜散電荷必須低到 10⁻⁹ 到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度等級。SPring-8 以時間相關單光子計數（TCSPC）量束團純度：光二極體或 APD 計數每個光子相對射頻的到達時間，建立 2436 個桶的直方圖；再以共振的 RF 擊出把不要的桶內電子激發到孔徑外。要量到 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度，統計計數必須累積到 10¹¹ 以上，所以量測時間與偵測器的計數率、死時間直接相關。~Time-resolved experiments need isolated single bunches whose neighbouring buckets carry stray charge at the 10⁻⁹ to 10⁻¹⁰ purity level. SPring-8 measures bunch purity with time-correlated single-photon counting (TCSPC): a photodiode or APD timestamps each photon against the RF and builds a histogram over the 2436 buckets, and a resonant RF knock-out drives electrons in unwanted buckets out of the aperture. Measuring a purity of 10⁻¹⁰ requires more than 10¹¹ accumulated counts, so measurement time is tied directly to detector count rate and dead time.
units.model: APD 計數率 1×10⁶ s⁻¹、量測 1 h：總計數 3.6×10⁹，10⁻⁹ 的衛星桶平均只有 3.6 個計數，統計誤差 √3.6 ≈ 1.9（53%）。要把 10⁻¹⁰ 的純度量到 10% 的相對誤差需 100 個衛星計數，即主束團 10¹² 個計數，在 10⁶ s⁻¹ 下約需 10⁶ s；實務上必須以閘控把主束團的計數衰減 10³ 倍以上，才能在數小時內完成。~With an APD count rate of 1×10⁶ s⁻¹ and a 1 h measurement, the total is 3.6×10⁹ counts and a satellite bucket at 10⁻⁹ averages only 3.6 counts with a statistical error of √3.6 ≈ 1.9 (53%). Measuring 10⁻¹⁰ purity to 10% relative error needs 100 satellite counts, that is 10¹² main-bunch counts, about 10⁶ s at 10⁶ s⁻¹; in practice the main-bunch counts must be gated down by more than 10³ to finish within hours.
units.verify: 以已知純度的填充（例如先以擊出清空再故意注入微量衛星）校正 TCSPC 的時間軸與閘控效率；比較擊出前後的直方圖確認衛星桶下降幅度；核對偵測器死時間造成的堆積效應，必要時以中性密度衰減片降低計數率重複量測，純度值應不隨計數率改變。~Calibrate the TCSPC time axis and gating efficiency with a fill of known purity (clear with knock-out, then deliberately inject a trace satellite); compare histograms before and after knock-out to confirm the satellite reduction; check pile-up from detector dead time and, if needed, repeat with neutral-density attenuation at a lower count rate, where the purity value must not change with rate.
units.failure: 偵測器的餘輝或電纜反射在主束團之後 2 ns 處產生假訊號，被誤判成衛星束團；操作人員據此加強擊出，反而把主束團的電荷也擊掉一部分，壽命與通量一起下降而純度數字沒有變好。~Detector afterpulsing or cable reflections create a false signal 2 ns after the main bunch that is mistaken for a satellite; operators then strengthen the knock-out, which also removes part of the main bunch, so lifetime and flux fall while the purity figure never improves.
units.misconception: 只要注入時只填一個桶，束團純度就自動完美。~Filling only one bucket at injection automatically gives perfect bunch purity.

units.anchor: 同調分率計算（1 Å）~Coherent-fraction calculation (1 Å)
units.title: 同調分率、繞射極限與亮度增益~Coherent fraction, diffraction limit and brilliance gain
units.mechanism: 同調成像、X 光光子相關光譜與奈米聚焦使用的是光束中橫向同調的部分，其比例近似為 (λ/4π)² 除以電子束與繞射項合成的相空間面積。在 1 Å 波長，λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad；SPring-8 現行水平發射度 2.4 nm·rad 使同調分率只有千分之幾，而 SPring-8-II 的 50 pm·rad 把它提高數十倍，這才是升級真正的驅動力，而不是總通量。~Coherent imaging, X-ray photon correlation spectroscopy and nanofocusing use only the transversely coherent part of the beam, whose fraction is roughly (λ/4π)² divided by the phase-space area of electron beam plus diffraction terms. At 1 Å wavelength λ/4π ≈ 8 pm·rad; the present SPring-8 horizontal emittance of 2.4 nm·rad leaves a coherent fraction of a few tenths of a percent, while the 50 pm·rad of SPring-8-II raises it by tens of times, and that gain, not total flux, is the real driver of the upgrade.
units.model: F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)]，ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm（λ = 1 Å）。現行：ε_x = 2400 pm、ε_y = 10 pm（教學假設）→ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.0033×0.44 ≈ 0.15%。SPring-8-II：ε_x = 50 pm → (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 0.138×0.44 ≈ 6.1%，同調分率提高約 40 倍；電流 100→200 mA 再把同調通量乘 2。~F_c ≈ [ε_r/(ε_x + ε_r)]·[ε_r/(ε_y + ε_r)] with ε_r = λ/4π = 8 pm at λ = 1 Å. Present: ε_x = 2400 pm, ε_y = 10 pm (teaching assumption) gives (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.0033×0.44 ≈ 0.15%. SPring-8-II: ε_x = 50 pm gives (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 0.138×0.44 ≈ 6.1%, about 40 times higher, and the current step from 100 to 200 mA doubles the coherent flux again.
units.verify: 在光束線以楊氏雙狹縫或針孔對掃描不同間距的條紋可見度，取得橫向同調長度並換算同調分率；與用針孔相機量到的發射度和 β 函數算出的預測值比較；以同調繞射成像的重建品質作為最終的使用者端驗證。~On a beamline scan fringe visibility with a Young double slit or pinhole pair at several separations to obtain the transverse coherence length and convert it to a coherent fraction; compare with the prediction from pinhole-camera emittance and the β function; and use the reconstruction quality of coherent diffraction imaging as the final user-side verification.
units.failure: 單色器或聚焦鏡的斜率誤差與振動會破壞波前，使實際可用的同調分率遠低於光源計算值；只在光源端驗收而不在樣品端量條紋可見度，升級的同調增益會在光學鏈中被吃掉。~Slope errors and vibration of the monochromator or focusing mirror corrupt the wavefront so the usable coherent fraction falls far below the source calculation; accepting only at the source without measuring fringe visibility at the sample lets the upgrade's coherence gain be eaten in the optics chain.
units.misconception: 總通量不變，同調分率就不會改變。~If total flux is unchanged, the coherent fraction cannot change.

units.anchor: 同一隧道換環：周長縮短 0.52 m~Same-tunnel ring swap: circumference shortened by 0.52 m
units.title: SPring-8-II 整合：周長、射頻頻率與一年停機~SPring-8-II integration: circumference, RF frequency and the one-year blackout
units.mechanism: SPring-8-II 在既有 1436 m 隧道內更換整座儲存環，目標停機期約一年。新晶格的周長 1435.428 m 比現行 1435.949 m 短 0.521 m，諧波數若維持 2436，射頻頻率必須上移；所有磁鐵與真空腔先在樑架上預組裝並完成對準，停機期只做拆舊、吊裝與連接。光束線的光源點必須保留，而降能後每支波盪器都要換成更短週期的 IVU-II 才能維持原有的光子能量範圍。~SPring-8-II replaces the whole storage ring inside the existing 1436 m tunnel with a target blackout of about one year. The new lattice circumference of 1435.428 m is 0.521 m shorter than the present 1435.949 m, so with the harmonic number kept at 2436 the RF frequency must rise; all magnets and chambers are pre-assembled and aligned on girders so that the blackout covers only removal, rigging and connection. Beamline source points must be preserved, and after the energy reduction every undulator is replaced by a shorter-period IVU-II to keep its photon-energy range.
units.model: f_RF = h·c/C：現行 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz；新環 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz，上移約 184 kHz，腔體調諧與低階模濾波器都要涵蓋。波盪器：λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ²，8→6 GeV 時 γ² 乘 0.5625，λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的基頻從 5.55 keV 掉到 3.12 keV；要維持 5.55 keV 可改用 λ_u = 18 mm（相同 K）或維持 32 mm 把 K 降到 1.36。~f_RF = h·c/C: present 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.949 ≈ 508.58 MHz; new ring 2436×2.998×10⁸/1435.428 ≈ 508.77 MHz, a rise of about 184 kHz that cavity tuners and low-level RF must cover. Undulators: λ₁ ∝ λ_u(1+K²/2)/γ², and going from 8 to 6 GeV multiplies γ² by 0.5625, so the 5.55 keV fundamental of λ_u = 32 mm at K = 2.2 drops to 3.12 keV; keeping 5.55 keV needs λ_u = 18 mm at the same K, or 32 mm with K lowered to 1.36.
units.verify: 停機前用雷射追蹤儀與靜水壓水平建立隧道基準網並記錄每條光束線的光源點；樑架在組裝廠完成磁鐵中心對準後整體運入，安裝後再量一次並與基準比較；射頻腔在新頻率下做冷測與高功率老練；每支新波盪器重做 K(g) 表並在光束線掃描核對。~Before the blackout build the tunnel reference network with laser tracker and hydrostatic levelling and record every beamline's source point; align magnet centres on each girder in the assembly hall, transport it as a unit, re-survey after installation and compare with the network; cold-test and high-power condition the RF cavities at the new frequency; and remake the K(g) table of every new undulator with beamline scans.
units.failure: 若周長縮短後射頻頻率沒有同步變更，或腔體調諧範圍不足 184 kHz，束流根本無法儲存；若樑架搬運中磁鐵相對位置鬆動而沒有重新量測，閉軌畸變超過校正磁鐵能力，第一圈就找不到束流。~If the RF frequency is not changed with the shorter circumference, or the cavity tuning range is short of 184 kHz, no beam can be stored at all; if magnets shift on a girder during transport and are not re-surveyed, closed-orbit distortion exceeds the correctors' reach and the first turn cannot be found.
units.misconception: 隧道不變，射頻頻率就可以沿用。~If the tunnel is unchanged, the RF frequency can stay the same.

units.anchor: 驗收矩陣：發射度、電流、用電~Acceptance matrix: emittance, current, electricity
units.title: 綠色升級的驗收指標與交接~Acceptance metrics and handoff of a green upgrade
units.mechanism: SPring-8-II 的驗收同時包含光源性能與用電：發射度 50 pm·rad、電流 200 mA、亮度提升、以及永磁彎轉磁鐵與降能帶來的電力節省。射頻功率由 U₀·I 決定，彎轉磁鐵改用永磁後磁鐵電源的用電歸零，但阻尼扭擺磁鐵增加的輻射損失要由射頻補回；交接文件必須把每一項性能指標對應到量測方法、不確定度與運轉條件，使用者設施才能據此排程。~Acceptance of SPring-8-II covers both source performance and electricity: 50 pm·rad emittance, 200 mA, the brilliance gain, and the power saved by permanent-magnet bends and the lower energy. RF power follows from U₀·I; permanent-magnet dipoles eliminate magnet power-supply consumption, but the extra radiation loss of damping wigglers must be restored by the RF; the handoff document must map every performance metric to a measurement method, an uncertainty and an operating condition before users can schedule on it.
units.model: 現行：U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV、100 mA → 束流射頻功率 0.92 MW。新環：6 GeV、等效 ρ 取 45 m（教學假設）→ U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV，加阻尼扭擺 1.2 倍 → 約 5.6 MeV，200 mA → 1.12 MW；射頻功率略增，但 88 顆電磁彎轉磁鐵各 20 kW（教學假設）共 1.76 MW 的磁鐵電力歸零，整體仍淨省。~Present: U₀ ≈ 9.2 MeV at 100 mA gives 0.92 MW of beam RF power. New ring: 6 GeV with an effective ρ of 45 m (teaching assumption) gives U₀ = 88.46×1296/45 ≈ 2.55 MeV, plus 1.2 times that for damping wigglers, about 5.6 MeV, so 1.12 MW at 200 mA; RF power rises slightly, but the 1.76 MW drawn by 88 electromagnetic dipoles at 20 kW each (teaching assumption) goes to zero, leaving a net saving.
units.verify: 以電力計分別記錄磁鐵電源、射頻與低溫（若有）的用電並與升級前比較；用針孔相機與 LOCO 模型驗證 50 pm 的發射度，用 DCCT 驗證 200 mA 與壽命；在代表性光束線以相同光學配置量升級前後的亮度比與同調分率；把所有數據連同量測不確定度寫入交接報告。~Log magnet power-supply, RF and any cryogenic electricity separately with power meters and compare with pre-upgrade values; verify 50 pm emittance with pinhole camera and LOCO model and 200 mA with lifetime from the DCCT; measure the brilliance ratio and coherent fraction before and after on representative beamlines with identical optics; and write all data with measurement uncertainties into the handoff report.
units.failure: 若驗收只看峰值亮度而不綁定運轉條件，使用者拿到的可能是壽命僅數小時、頂注頻繁、光束線快門常關的機器，帳面指標達標但有效束流時間反而減少。~If acceptance looks only at peak brilliance without binding it to operating conditions, users may receive a machine with a lifetime of a few hours, frequent top-ups and shutters often closed: the headline metric is met while effective beam time falls.
units.misconception: 升級後總用電一定下降，因為電子能量降低了。~Total electricity must fall after the upgrade because the electron energy is lower.

example: 降能換週期練習：SPring-8 一支 λ_u = 32 mm、K = 2.2 的真空內波盪器在 8 GeV（γ² = 2.45×10⁸）的基頻 λ₁ = 0.032×(1+2.42)/(2×2.45×10⁸) ≈ 2.23 Å，即 5.55 keV。SPring-8-II 降到 6 GeV（γ² = 1.38×10⁸），同一波盪器基頻變成 5.55×(6/8)² ≈ 3.12 keV。要維持 5.55 keV，可（a）維持 K = 2.2 而把週期縮到 λ_u = 32×0.5625 ≈ 18 mm，或（b）維持 32 mm 而把 (1+K²/2) 降到 3.42×0.5625 ≈ 1.92，即 K ≈ 1.36。同調分率在 1 Å（ε_r = 8 pm）：現行 ε_x = 2400 pm、ε_y = 10 pm → F_c ≈ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.15%；升級後 ε_x = 50 pm → (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 6.1%，提高約 40 倍，再乘上電流 100→200 mA 的 2 倍，同調通量約提高 80 倍。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Lower-energy period-swap exercise: a SPring-8 in-vacuum undulator with λ_u = 32 mm and K = 2.2 at 8 GeV (γ² = 2.45×10⁸) has fundamental λ₁ = 0.032×(1+2.42)/(2×2.45×10⁸) ≈ 2.23 Å, that is 5.55 keV. After SPring-8-II lowers the energy to 6 GeV (γ² = 1.38×10⁸) the same device gives 5.55×(6/8)² ≈ 3.12 keV. To keep 5.55 keV, either (a) keep K = 2.2 and shorten the period to λ_u = 32×0.5625 ≈ 18 mm, or (b) keep 32 mm and reduce (1+K²/2) to 3.42×0.5625 ≈ 1.92, that is K ≈ 1.36. Coherent fraction at 1 Å (ε_r = 8 pm): present ε_x = 2400 pm and ε_y = 10 pm give F_c ≈ (8/2408)×(8/18) ≈ 0.15%; after the upgrade ε_x = 50 pm gives (8/58)×(8/18) ≈ 6.1%, about 40 times higher, and the current step from 100 to 200 mA doubles it again, so coherent flux rises about 80-fold. Values are teaching assumptions, not any facility's specification.
history: SPring-8 位於兵庫縣播磨科學公園都市，由理化學研究所與日本原子力研究所共同建造，1997 年 10 月開放使用者，以 8 GeV 成為能量最高的第三代同步輻射光源，並率先大量採用真空內波盪器。相鄰的 X 光自由電子雷射 SACLA 於 2011 年首次出光，2020 年起兼任儲存環的注入器。SPring-8-II 升級計畫由理研與 JASRI 推動，將以 6 GeV 五彎消色散晶格與阻尼扭擺磁鐵把發射度降到 50 pm·rad，停機期目標約一年。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯。~SPring-8 stands in the Harima Science Garden City of Hyogo Prefecture, built jointly by RIKEN and the Japan Atomic Energy Research Institute; it opened to users in October 1997 as the highest-energy third-generation synchrotron at 8 GeV and pioneered the wide use of in-vacuum undulators. The neighbouring X-ray free-electron laser SACLA first lased in 2011 and has also served as the ring's injector since 2020. The SPring-8-II upgrade, driven by RIKEN and JASRI, will use a 6 GeV five-bend achromat with damping wigglers to reach 50 pm·rad with a blackout of about one year. This course reconstructs only public principles and engineering logic.
